read.thesis: Quanta raised FY26 guidance again (adj EPS $17.90–18.30) with Q3 backlog at a record $63.7B, up 45% y/y, and Electric margin expanding to 12.6%; no capacity-discipline evidence either way.

triggers.label: FY26 adj EPS raised to $17.90–18.30
triggers.quote: Quanta also now expects diluted earnings per share attributable to common stock to range between $12.57 and $12.97 and adjusted diluted earnings per share attributable to common stock to range between $17.90 and $18.30.

triggers.label: Total backlog record $63.7B
triggers.quote: total backlog reached a record $63.7 billion

guidance.quote: revenues to range between $41.3 billion and $41.6 billion
adjusted diluted earnings per share attributable to common stock to range between $17.90 and $18.30
adjusted EBITDA to range between $4.40 billion and $4.49 billion
free cash flow (a financial measure) to range between $2.50 billion and $3.00 billion
We believe there is opportunity to deliver strong double-digit adjusted EPS growth in 2027

red_flags.label: Working capital build: AR up ~48% vs contract liabilities up ~70%
